scripts.lint: biome ci --error-on-warnings core shared scripts web package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: biome check --write core shared scripts web package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts
